main.description: Move the authenticated account's records into its private space, or back to its public repo, server-side, by the same rules as a client's batched move and without its rate limits. Optional: a PDS may serve it. Clients try it first and fall back to batches on MethodNotImplemented. Called on the account's own PDS with its session.

refused.description: Records the move left where they were because the other side refused them. The owner may delete them.

errors.name: SpaceNotFound
errors.description: The account has no private space.
